requirements.R_TOKEN_BIND: Jenkins credential id sonarqube-token authenticates to Sonar using the TFC analysis token after reload.
requirements.R_INSTALL_URL: Named SonarQube installation serverUrl is the ingress https host, not the JDBC/RDS hostname.
requirements.R_SECRET_KEYS: K8s secret keys and Helm mount keyNames match sonarqube-token, artifactory-username, artifactory-password, and db password.
requirements.R_INGRESS_GROUP: jenkins, sonar, and artifactory share group.name platform-ingress on one TLS listener.
requirements.R_DNS_OWNER: ExternalDNS publishes those three platform.test names with txtOwnerId platform-mvp-dev.
requirements.R_JDBC: Sonar JDBC uses jdbc:postgresql://ADDRESS:5432/sonarqube against the RDS ternary identity with secret key password.
requirements.R_EFS: Jenkins home stays on the access-point path owned by uid 1000; Artifactory data is a separate path; reclaim is Retain.
requirements.R_SCHEDULE: Controller numExecutors is 0 and the controller stays on platform-control with the control taint.
requirements.R_SSM: Ansible dispatch uses aws_ssm and ANSIBLE_RUNNER_ID; SSH and on-prem inventory are rejected.
requirements.R_IDEMPOTENT: A second reload keeps the same analysis token and preserves Jenkins home contents.
requirements.R_SONAR_UP: Sonar /api/system/status is UP only when JDBC identity is valid; bind must not succeed while DOWN.
